hooks.name: Session Start — Project Status
hooks.description: Reads the active cloud-dive tasks.md at session start and prints a short status

action.prompt:
At the start of this session, read `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/tasks.md` (the active plan; `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` is the completed baseline) and produce a brief status so the agent knows where work left off.

Count `[x]` and `[ ]` per priority section (P0, P1, P2, P3, Submission). Output, under 15 lines:

## Cloud Dive — Session Start Status
**Progress:** X / Y tasks (N%)
**Days to deadline:** days from today (UTC) to 2026-12-04
**Active section:** first section with an open task
**Next task:** first open task id and short description
**Open decisions:** any of D1–D5 in `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/requirements.md` §5 still marked Open
**Usage log:** number of rows in `docs/kiro-usage-log.md` (or "missing")
